newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kuwait Petroleum Corp cuts oil price by 10 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Petroleum Corp cuts oil price by 10 cts/bbl.

text.p: Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) has lowered its official selling price for its crude by 10 cents per barrel to Arab Medium minus 20 cents, effective July 1, traders said on Monday.

Traders said that KPC was under pressure from Japanese and other refiners to reduce prices in light of extremely weak values for Middle East grades in Asia and growing competition for Far East business.
"KPC has been losing far eastern market share, and is making a bid to get some of it back," said one Japan trader.
"This makes them more competitive against Saudi Arabia, as well as against Iraqi Basrah, and non-Middle East grades like Alaska North Slope," said a trader with a Japanese refiner.
